what: Two launch chains for the single W8 GO were started: the parent bash job and a worker command (~01:37:38 and ~01:37:42). Exactly one gate receipt/launch record/supervisor receipt exists (supervisor 37255, child 37258); the later chain refused on the exclusive stability-gate receipt (FileExistsError) and spawned no supervisor. Parent bash output shows gate PASS and EXIT=0 with wall 38.49s matching supervisor wall 38.3s.
cause: Parent launched after the worker announced it was stopping at its request cap; the worker still had the GO message and launched. Ownership handoff was not explicit.
correction: The earlier parent audit sentence attributing the worker message to the same launch is incomplete; this record supersedes it on attribution. No scientific effect; exclusive receipts prevented a duplicate run.
rule_going_forward: Parent launches only after explicitly telling the worker that the parent owns the launch (done for PA19 run-002 GO: owner_launch=parent).
